sloka: क्षिप्रं त्वं देवि शोकस्य पारं यास्यसि मैथिलि ।रावणं चैव रामेण निहतं द्रक्ष्यसे ऽचिरात् ।। ५.३९.४६।।।।
transliteration: kṣipraṁ tvaṁ devi śokasya pāraṁ yāsyasi maithili ।rāvaṇaṁ caiva rāmeṇa nihataṁ drakṣyase 'cirāt ।। 5.39.46।।।।

translations.english: "O queen Mythili you come to the end of your sorrow and will soon see Ravana killed by Rama".
